description: List Feed API order report tasks (LMS_ORDER_REPORT) by feedType or scheduleId (not both), filtered by dateRange or lookBackDays (not both), with limit/offset paging. Requires sell.fulfillment.

dateRange.description: Task creation window in UTC, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z..2026-09-08T00:00:00.000Z (at most 90 days); do not combine with lookBackDays

feedType.description: LMS_ORDER_REPORT (the only supported value); do not combine with scheduleId

lookBackDays.description: Search tasks created in the last 1-90 days (eBay default 7); do not combine with dateRange

offset.description: Zero-based number of results to skip (default 0)

scheduleId.description: Only tasks generated by this schedule; do not combine with feedType

name: ebay_get_order_tasks
